body_text: (A) if no work is being or will be undertaken to have the application approved,
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(1)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(1)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) if the Secretary has determined that the application is not approvable and all legal appeals have been exhausted,
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(1)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(1)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) if approval of the application under subsection (c) is withdrawn and all legal appeals have been exhausted,
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(1)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(1)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (D) if the Secretary has determined that such drug is not a new drug, or
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(1)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(1)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (E) upon the effective date of the approval of the first application under subsection (j) which refers to such drug or upon the date upon which the approval of an application under subsection (j) which refers to such drug could be made effective if such an application had been submitted.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(1)(E) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(1)(E)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (2) Action Package for Approval.—
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) Action package.—The Secretary shall publish the action package for approval of an application under subsection (b) or section 262 of title 42 on the Internet Web site of the Food and Drug Administration—
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) not later than 30 days after the date of approval of such applications—
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (I) for a drug, no active moiety (as defined by the Secretary in section 314.3 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations)) of which has been approved in any other application under this section; or
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(A)(i)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(A)(i)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (II) for a biological product, no active ingredient of which has been approved in any other application under section 262 of title 42; and
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(A)(i)(II) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(A)(i)(II)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) not later than 30 days after the third request for such action package for approval received under section 552 of title 5 for any other drug or biological product.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) Immediate publication of summary review.—Notwithstanding subparagraph (A), the Secretary shall publish, on the Internet Web site of the Food and Drug Administration, the materials described in subparagraph (C)(iv) not later than 48 hours after the date of approval of the drug, except where such materials require redaction by the Secretary.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) Contents.—An action package for approval of an application under subparagraph (A) shall be dated and shall include the following:
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) Documents generated by the Food and Drug Administration related to review of the application.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) Documents pertaining to the format and content of the application generated during drug development.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iii) Labeling submitted by the applicant.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(iii) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(iii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iv) A summary review that documents conclusions from all reviewing disciplines about the drug, noting any critical issues and disagreements with the applicant and within the review team and how they were resolved, recommendations for action, and an explanation of any nonconcurrence with review conclusions.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(iv) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(iv)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (v) The Division Director and Office Director's decision document which includes—
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(v) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(v)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (I) a brief statement of concurrence with the summary review;
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(v)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(v)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (II) a separate review or addendum to the review if disagreeing with the summary review; and
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(v)(II) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(v)(II)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (III) a separate review or addendum to the review to add further analysis.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(v)(III) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(v)(III)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (vi) Identification by name of each officer or employee of the Food and Drug Administration who—
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(vi) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(vi)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (I) participated in the decision to approve the application; and
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(vi)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(vi)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (II) consents to have his or her name included in the package.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(C)(vi)(II) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(C)(vi)(II)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (D) Review.—A scientific review of an application is considered the work of the reviewer and shall not be altered by management or the reviewer once final.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (E) Confidential information.—This paragraph does not authorize the disclosure of any trade secret, confidential commercial or financial information, or other matter listed in section 552(b) of title 5.
top_caption: Public disclosure of safety and effectiveness data and action package
label: FD&C Act § 505(l)(2)(E) [21 U.S.C. 355(l)(2)(E)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this section, the term "patent" means a patent issued by the United States Patent and Trademark Office.
label: FD&C Act § 505(m) [21 U.S.C. 355(m)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (1) For the purpose of providing expert scientific advice and recommendations to the Secretary regarding a clinical investigation of a drug or the approval for marketing of a drug under this section or section 262 of title 42, the Secretary shall establish panels of experts or use panels of experts established before November 21, 1997, or both.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (2) The Secretary may delegate the appointment and oversight authority granted under section 394 of this title to a director of a center or successor entity within the Food and Drug Administration.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (3) The Secretary shall make appointments to each panel established under paragraph (1) so that each panel shall consist of—
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) members who are qualified by training and experience to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the drugs to be referred to the panel and who, to the extent feasible, possess skill and experience in the development, manufacture, or utilization of such drugs;
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(3)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(3)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) members with diverse expertise in such fields as clinical and administrative medicine, pharmacy, pharmacology, pharmacoeconomics, biological and physical sciences, and other related professions;
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) a representative of consumer interests, and a representative of interests of the drug manufacturing industry not directly affected by the matter to be brought before the panel; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(3)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(3)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (D) two or more members who are specialists or have other expertise in the particular disease or condition for which the drug under review is proposed to be indicated.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(3)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(3)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Scientific, trade, and consumer organizations shall be afforded an opportunity to nominate individuals for appointment to the panels. No individual who is in the regular full-time employ of the United States and engaged in the administration of this chapter may be a voting member of any panel. The Secretary shall designate one of the members of each panel to serve as chairman thereof.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(3)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(3)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (4) The Secretary shall, as appropriate, provide education and training to each new panel member before such member participates in a panel's activities, including education regarding requirements under this chapter and related regulations of the Secretary, and the administrative processes and procedures related to panel meetings.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(4) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(4)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (5) Panel members (other than officers or employees of the United States), while attending meetings or conferences of a panel or otherwise engaged in its business, shall be entitled to receive compensation for each day so engaged, including traveltime, at rates to be fixed by the Secretary, but not to exceed the daily equivalent of the rate in effect for positions classified above grade GS–15 of the General Schedule. While serving away from their homes or regular places of business, panel members may be allowed travel expenses (including per diem in lieu of subsistence) as authorized by section 5703 of title 5, for persons in the Government service employed intermittently.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(5) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(5)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (6) The Secretary shall ensure that scientific advisory panels meet regularly and at appropriate intervals so that any matter to be reviewed by such a panel can be presented to the panel not more than 60 days after the matter is ready for such review. Meetings of the panel may be held using electronic communication to convene the meetings.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(6) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(6)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (7) Within 90 days after a scientific advisory panel makes recommendations on any matter under its review, the Food and Drug Administration official responsible for the matter shall review the conclusions and recommendations of the panel, and notify the affected persons of the final decision on the matter, or of the reasons that no such decision has been reached. Each such final decision shall be documented including the rationale for the decision.
label: FD&C Act § 505(n)(7) [21 U.S.C. 355(n)(7)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (o) Postmarket studies and clinical trials; labeling
label: FD&C Act § 505(o) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: A responsible person may not introduce or deliver for introduction into interstate commerce the new drug involved if the person is in violation of a requirement established under paragraph (3) or (4) with respect to the drug.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this subsection:
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The term "responsible person" means a person who—
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) has submitted to the Secretary a covered application that is pending; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) is the holder of an approved covered application.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The term "covered application" means—
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) an application under subsection (b) for a drug that is subject to section 353(b) of this title; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) an application under section 262 of title 42.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) New safety information; serious risk
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The terms "new safety information", "serious risk", and "signal of a serious risk" have the meanings given such terms in section 355–1(b) of this title.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(2)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(2)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For any or all of the purposes specified in subparagraph (B), the Secretary may, subject to subparagraph (D), require a responsible person for a drug to conduct a postapproval study or studies of the drug, or a postapproval clinical trial or trials of the drug, on the basis of scientific data deemed appropriate by the Secretary, including information regarding chemically-related or pharmacologically-related drugs.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(A)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: Purposes of study or clinical trial
body_text: The purposes referred to in this subparagraph with respect to a postapproval study or postapproval clinical trial are the following:
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) To assess a known serious risk related to the use of the drug involved.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) To assess signals of serious risk related to the use of the drug.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iii) To identify an unexpected serious risk when available data indicates the potential for a serious risk.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(B)(iii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(B)(iii)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: Establishment of requirement after approval of covered application
body_text: The Secretary may require a postapproval study or studies or postapproval clinical trial or trials for a drug for which an approved covered application is in effect as of the date on which the Secretary seeks to establish such requirement only if the Secretary becomes aware of new safety information.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary may not require the responsible person to conduct a study under this paragraph, unless the Secretary makes a determination that the reports under subsection (k)(1) and the active postmarket risk identification and analysis system as available under subsection (k)(3) will not be sufficient to meet the purposes set forth in subparagraph (B).
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(D)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(D)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary may not require the responsible person to conduct a clinical trial under this paragraph, unless the Secretary makes a determination that a postapproval study or studies will not be sufficient to meet the purposes set forth in subparagraph (B).
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(D)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(D)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (E) Notification; timetables; periodic reports
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(E) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(E)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall notify the responsible person regarding a requirement under this paragraph to conduct a postapproval study or clinical trial by the target dates for communication of feedback from the review team to the responsible person regarding proposed labeling and postmarketing study commitments as set forth in the letters described in section 101(c) of the Food and Drug Administration Amendments Act of 2007.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(E)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(E)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) Timetable; periodic reports
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(E)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(E)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For each study or clinical trial required to be conducted under this paragraph, the Secretary shall require that the responsible person submit a timetable for completion of the study or clinical trial. With respect to each study required to be conducted under this paragraph or otherwise undertaken by the responsible person to investigate a safety issue, the Secretary shall require the responsible person to periodically report to the Secretary on the status of such study including whether any difficulties in completing the study have been encountered. With respect to each clinical trial required to be conducted under this paragraph or otherwise undertaken by the responsible person to investigate a safety issue, the Secretary shall require the responsible person to periodically report to the Secretary on the status of such clinical trial including whether enrollment has begun, the number of participants enrolled, the expected completion date, whether any difficulties completing the clinical trial have been encountered, and registration information with respect to the requirements under section 282(j) of title 42. If the responsible person fails to comply with such timetable or violates any other requirement of this subparagraph, the responsible person shall be considered in violation of this subsection, unless the responsible person demonstrates good cause for such noncompliance or such other violation. The Secretary shall determine what constitutes good cause under the preceding sentence.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(E)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(E)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The responsible person may appeal a requirement to conduct a study or clinical trial under this paragraph using dispute resolution procedures established by the Secretary in regulation and guidance.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(3)(F) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(3)(F)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: New safety or new effectiveness information
body_text: If the Secretary becomes aware of new information, including any new safety information or information related to reduced effectiveness, that the Secretary determines should be included in the labeling of the drug, the Secretary shall promptly notify the responsible person or, if the same drug approved under subsection (b) is not currently marketed, the holder of an approved application under subsection (j).
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Following notification pursuant to subparagraph (A), the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) shall within 30 days—
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) submit a supplement proposing changes to the approved labeling to reflect the new safety information, including changes to boxed warnings, contraindications, warnings, precautions, or adverse reactions, or new effectiveness information; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) notify the Secretary that the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) does not believe a labeling change is warranted and submit a statement detailing the reasons why such a change is not warranted.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Upon receipt of such supplement, the Secretary shall promptly review and act upon such supplement. If the Secretary disagrees with the proposed changes in the supplement or with the statement setting forth the reasons why no labeling change is necessary, the Secretary shall initiate discussions to reach agreement on whether the labeling for the drug should be modified to reflect the new safety or new effectiveness information, and if so, the contents of such labeling changes.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Such discussions shall not extend for more than 30 days after the response to the notification under subparagraph (B), unless the Secretary determines an extension of such discussion period is warranted.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Within 15 days of the conclusion of the discussions under subparagraph (D), the Secretary may issue an order directing the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) to make such a labeling change as the Secretary deems appropriate to address the new safety or new effectiveness information. Within 15 days of such an order, the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) shall submit a supplement containing the labeling change.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(E) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(E)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Within 5 days of receiving an order under subparagraph (E), the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) may appeal using dispute resolution procedures established by the Secretary in regulation and guidance.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(F) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(F)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: If the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) has not submitted a supplement within 15 days of the date of such order under subparagraph (E), and there is no appeal or dispute resolution proceeding pending, the responsible person or holder shall be considered to be in violation of this subsection. If at the conclusion of any dispute resolution procedures the Secretary determines that a supplement must be submitted and such a supplement is not submitted within 15 days of the date of that determination, the responsible person or holder shall be in violation of this subsection.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(G) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(G)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Notwithstanding subparagraphs (A) through (F), if the Secretary concludes that such a labeling change is necessary to protect the public health, the Secretary may accelerate the timelines in such subparagraphs.
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(H) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(H)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: This paragraph shall not be construed to affect the responsibility of the responsible person or the holder of the approved application under subsection (j) to maintain its label in accordance with existing requirements, including subpart B of part 201 and sections 314.70 and 601.12 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations).
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(4)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(4)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Determinations by the Secretary under this subsection for a drug shall be made by individuals at or above the level of individuals empowered to approve a drug (such as division directors within the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research).
label: FD&C Act § 505(o)(5) [21 U.S.C. 355(o)(5)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: A person may not introduce or deliver for introduction into interstate commerce a new drug if—
label: FD&C Act § 505(p)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(p)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A)(i) the application for such drug is approved under subsection (b) or (j) and is subject to section 353(b) of this title; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(p)(1)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(p)(1)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) the application for such drug is approved under section 262 of title 42; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(p)(1)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(p)(1)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) a risk evaluation and mitigation strategy is required under section 355–1 of this title with respect to the drug and the person fails to maintain compliance with the requirements of the approved strategy or with other requirements under section 355–1 of this title, including requirements regarding assessments of approved strategies.
label: FD&C Act § 505(p)(1)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(p)(1)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The failure to conduct a postmarket study under section 356 of this title, subpart H of part 314, or subpart E of part 601 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations), is deemed to be a violation of paragraph (1).
label: FD&C Act § 505(p)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(p)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall not delay approval of a pending application submitted under subsection (b)(2) or (j) of this section or section 262(k) of title 42 because of any request to take any form of action relating to the application, either before or during consideration of the request, unless—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) the request is in writing and is a petition submitted to the Secretary pursuant to section 10.30 or 10.35 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations); and
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) the Secretary determines, upon reviewing the petition, that a delay is necessary to protect the public health.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Consideration of the petition shall be separate and apart from review and approval of any application.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: If the Secretary determines under subparagraph (A) that a delay is necessary with respect to an application, the Secretary shall provide to the applicant, not later than 30 days after making such determination, the following information:
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) Notification of the fact that a determination under subparagraph (A) has been made.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) If applicable, any clarification or additional data that the applicant should submit to the docket on the petition to allow the Secretary to review the petition promptly.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iii) A brief summary of the specific substantive issues raised in the petition which form the basis of the determination.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(B)(iii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(B)(iii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The information described in subparagraph (B) shall be conveyed via either, at the discretion of the Secretary—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) a document; or
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(C)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(C)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) a meeting with the applicant involved.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(C)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(C)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Any information conveyed by the Secretary under subparagraph (C) shall be considered part of the application and shall be subject to the disclosure requirements applicable to information in such application.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(D)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: Denial based on intent to delay
body_text: If the Secretary determines that a petition or a supplement to the petition was submitted with the primary purpose of delaying the approval of an application and the petition does not on its face raise valid scientific or regulatory issues, the Secretary may deny the petition at any point based on such determination. The Secretary may issue guidance to describe the factors that will be used to determine under this subparagraph whether a petition is submitted with the primary purpose of delaying the approval of an application.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(E) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(E)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall take final agency action on a petition not later than 150 days after the date on which the petition is submitted. The Secretary shall not extend such period for any reason, including—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(F) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(F)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) any determination made under subparagraph (A);
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(F)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(F)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) the submission of comments relating to the petition or supplemental information supplied by the petitioner; or
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(F)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(F)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iii) the consent of the petitioner.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(F)(iii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(F)(iii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: If the filing of an application resulted in first-applicant status under subsection (j)(5)(D)(i)(IV) and approval of the application was delayed because of a petition, the 30-month period under such subsection is deemed to be extended by a period of time equal to the period beginning on the date on which the Secretary received the petition and ending on the date of final agency action on the petition (inclusive of such beginning and ending dates), without regard to whether the Secretary grants, in whole or in part, or denies, in whole or in part, the petition.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(G) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(G)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall not consider a petition for review unless the party submitting such petition does so in written form and the subject document is signed and contains the following certification: "I certify that, to my best knowledge and belief: (a) this petition includes all information and views upon which the petition relies; (b) this petition includes representative data and/or information known to the petitioner which are unfavorable to the petition; and (c) I have taken reasonable steps to ensure that any representative data and/or information which are unfavorable to the petition were disclosed to me. I further certify that the information upon which I have based the action requested herein first became known to the party on whose behalf this petition is submitted on or about the following date: ____________________. If I received or expect to receive payments, including cash and other forms of consideration, to file this information or its contents, I received or expect to receive those payments from the following persons or organizations: __________________________. I verify under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct as of the date of the submission of this petition.", with the date on which such information first became known to such party and the names of such persons or organizations inserted in the first and second blank space, respectively.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(H) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(H)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall not accept for review any supplemental information or comments on a petition unless the party submitting such information or comments does so in written form and the subject document is signed and contains the following verification: "I certify that, to my best knowledge and belief: (a) I have not intentionally delayed submission of this document or its contents; and (b) the information upon which I have based the action requested herein first became known to me on or about ____________________. If I received or expect to receive payments, including cash and other forms of consideration, to file this information or its contents, I received or expect to receive those payments from the following persons or organizations: __________. I verify under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct as of the date of the submission of this petition.", with the date on which such information first became known to the party and the names of such persons or organizations inserted in the first and second blank space, respectively.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(1)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(1)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall be considered to have taken final agency action on a petition if—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) during the 150-day period referred to in paragraph (1)(F), the Secretary makes a final decision within the meaning of section 10.45(d) of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulation); or
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) such period expires without the Secretary having made such a final decision.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: If a civil action is filed against the Secretary with respect to any issue raised in the petition before the Secretary has taken final agency action on the petition within the meaning of subparagraph (A), the court shall dismiss without prejudice the action for failure to exhaust administrative remedies.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of judicial review related to the approval of an application for which a petition under paragraph (1) was submitted, the administrative record regarding any issue raised by the petition shall include—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) the petition filed under paragraph (1) and any supplements and comments thereto;
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(C)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(C)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) the Secretary's response to such petition, if issued; and
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(C)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(C)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iii) other information, as designated by the Secretary, related to the Secretary's determinations regarding the issues raised in such petition, as long as the information was considered by the agency no later than the date of final agency action as defined under subparagraph (2)(A), and regardless of whether the Secretary responded to the petition at or before the approval of the application at issue in the petition.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(2)(C)(iii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(2)(C)(iii)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: Annual report on delays in approvals per petitions
body_text: The Secretary shall annually submit to the Congress a report that specifies—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) the number of applications that were approved during the preceding 12-month period;
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(3)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(3)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) the number of such applications whose effective dates were delayed by petitions referred to in paragraph (1) during such period;
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) the number of days by which such applications were so delayed; and
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(3)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(3)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (D) the number of such petitions that were submitted during such period.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(3)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(3)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) This subsection does not apply to—
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(4)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(4)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) a petition that relates solely to the timing of the approval of an application pursuant to subsection (j)(5)(B)(iv); or
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(4)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(4)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) a petition that is made by the sponsor of an application and that seeks only to have the Secretary take or refrain from taking any form of action with respect to that application.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(4)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(4)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) Paragraph (2) does not apply to a petition addressing issues concerning an application submitted pursuant to section 262(k) of title 42.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(4)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(4)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this subsection, the term "application" means an application submitted under subsection (b)(2) or (j) of this section or section 262(k) of title 42.
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(5)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(5)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this subsection, other than paragraph (1)(A)(i), the term "petition" means a request described in paragraph (1)(A)(i).
top_caption: Petitions and civil actions regarding approval of certain applications
label: FD&C Act § 505(q)(5)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(q)(5)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Not later than 1 year after September 27, 2007, the Secretary shall improve the transparency of information about drugs and allow patients and health care providers better access to information about drugs by developing and maintaining an Internet Web site that—
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) provides links to drug safety information listed in paragraph (2) for prescription drugs that are approved under this section or licensed under section 262 of title 42; and
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(1)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(1)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) improves communication of drug safety information to patients and providers.
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(1)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(1)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall carry out paragraph (1) by—
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) developing and maintaining an accessible, consolidated Internet Web site with easily searchable drug safety information, including the information found on United States Government Internet Web sites, such as the United States National Library of Medicine's Daily Med and Medline Plus Web sites, in addition to other such Web sites maintained by the Secretary;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) ensuring that the information provided on the Internet Web site is comprehensive and includes, when available and appropriate—
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) patient labeling and patient packaging inserts;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) a link to a list of each drug, whether approved under this section or licensed under such section 262, for which a Medication Guide, as provided for under part 208 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations), is required;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iii) a link to the registry and results data bank provided for under subsections (i) and (j) of section 282 of title 42;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(iii) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(iii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (iv) the most recent safety information and alerts issued by the Food and Drug Administration for drugs approved by the Secretary under this section, such as product recalls, warning letters, and import alerts;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(iv) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(iv)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (v) publicly available information about implemented RiskMAPs and risk evaluation and mitigation strategies under subsection (o);
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(v) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(v)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (vi) guidance documents and regulations related to drug safety; and
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(vi) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(vi)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (vii) other material determined appropriate by the Secretary;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(B)(vii) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(B)(vii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) providing access to summaries of the assessed and aggregated data collected from the active surveillance infrastructure under subsection (k)(3) to provide information of known and serious side-effects for drugs approved under this section or licensed under such section 262;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (D) preparing and making publicly available on the Internet website established under paragraph (1) best practices for drug safety surveillance activities for drugs approved under this section or section 262 of title 42;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(D) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(D)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (E) enabling patients, providers, and drug sponsors to submit adverse event reports through the Internet Web site;
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(E) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(E)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (F) providing educational materials for patients and providers about the appropriate means of disposing of expired, damaged, or unusable medications; and
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(F) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(F)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (G) supporting initiatives that the Secretary determines to be useful to fulfill the purposes of the Internet Web site.
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(2)(G) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(2)(G)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall post on the Internet Web site established under paragraph (1) the approved professional labeling and any required patient labeling of a drug approved under this section or licensed under such section 262 not later than 21 days after the date the drug is approved or licensed, including in a supplemental application with respect to a labeling change.
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: To ensure development of the Internet Web site by the date described in paragraph (1), the Secretary may, on a temporary or permanent basis, implement systems or products developed by private entities.
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(4) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(4)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary may enter into contracts with public and private entities to fulfill the requirements of this subsection.
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(5) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(5)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Advisory Committee on Risk Communication under section 360bbb–6 of this title shall, on a regular basis, perform a comprehensive review and evaluation of the types of risk communication information provided on the Internet Web site established under paragraph (1) and, through other means, shall identify, clarify, and define the purposes and types of information available to facilitate the efficient flow of information to patients and providers, and shall recommend ways for the Food and Drug Administration to work with outside entities to help facilitate the dispensing of risk communication information to patients and providers.
top_caption: Postmarket drug safety information for patients and providers
label: FD&C Act § 505(r)(6) [21 U.S.C. 355(r)(6)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall—
label: FD&C Act § 505(s) [21 U.S.C. 355(s)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (1) refer a drug or biological product to a Food and Drug Administration advisory committee for review at a meeting of such advisory committee prior to the approval of such drug or biological if it is—
label: FD&C Act § 505(s)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(s)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) a drug, no active moiety (as defined by the Secretary in section 314.3 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations)) of which has been approved in any other application under this section; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(s)(1)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(s)(1)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) a biological product, no active ingredient of which has been approved in any other application under section 262 of title 42; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(s)(1)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(s)(1)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (2) if the Secretary does not refer a drug or biological product described in paragraph (1) to a Food and Drug Administration advisory committee prior to such approval, provide in the action letter on the application for the drug or biological product a summary of the reasons why the Secretary did not refer the drug or biological product to an advisory committee prior to approval.
label: FD&C Act § 505(s)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(s)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Commissioner shall—
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(1)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(1)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) not later than 9 months after September 27, 2007, publish a complete list on the Internet Web site of the Food and Drug Administration of all authorized generic drugs (including drug trade name, brand company manufacturer, and the date the authorized generic drug entered the market); and
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(1)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(1)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) update the list quarterly to include each authorized generic drug included in an annual report submitted to the Secretary by the sponsor of a listed drug during the preceding 3-month period.
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(1)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(1)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Commissioner shall notify relevant Federal agencies, including the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services and the Federal Trade Commission, when the Commissioner first publishes the information described in subparagraph (A) that the information has been published and that the information will be updated quarterly.
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(1)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(1)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Commissioner shall include in the list described in paragraph (1) each authorized generic drug included in an annual report submitted to the Secretary by the sponsor of a listed drug after January 1, 1999.
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: In this section, the term "authorized generic drug" means a listed drug (as that term is used in subsection (j)) that—
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) has been approved under subsection (c); and
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(3)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(3)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) is marketed, sold, or distributed directly or indirectly to retail class of trade under a different labeling, packaging (other than repackaging as the listed drug in blister packs, unit doses, or similar packaging for use in institutions), product code, labeler code, trade name, or trade mark than the listed drug.
label: FD&C Act § 505(t)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(t)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of subsections (c)(3)(E)(ii) and (j)(5)(F)(ii), if an application is submitted under subsection (b) for a non-racemic drug containing as an active moiety (as defined by the Secretary in section 314.3 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations)) a single enantiomer that is contained in a racemic drug approved in another application under subsection (b), the applicant may, in the application for such non-racemic drug, elect to have the single enantiomer not be considered the same active moiety as that contained in the approved racemic drug, if—
label: FD&C Act § 505(u)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(u)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A)(i) the single enantiomer has not been previously approved except in the approved racemic drug; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(u)(1)(A)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(u)(1)(A)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) the application submitted under subsection (b) for such non-racemic drug—
label: FD&C Act § 505(u)(1)(A)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(u)(1)(A)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (I) includes full reports of new clinical investigations (other than bioavailability studies)—
label: FD&C Act § 505(u)(1)(A)(ii)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(u)(1)(A)(ii)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (aa) necessary for the approval of the application under subsections (c) and (d); and
label: FD&C Act § 505(aa) [21 U.S.C. 355(aa)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (bb) conducted or sponsored by the applicant; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (II) does not rely on any clinical investigations (other than bioavailability studies) that are part of an application submitted under subsection (b) for approval of the approved racemic drug; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(II) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(II)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) the application submitted under subsection (b) for such non-racemic drug is not submitted for approval of a condition of use—
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i) in a therapeutic category in which the approved racemic drug has been approved; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) for which any other enantiomer of the racemic drug has been approved.
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: No approval in certain therapeutic categories
body_text: Until the date that is 10 years after the date of approval of a non-racemic drug described in paragraph (1) and with respect to which the applicant has made the election provided for by such paragraph, the Secretary shall not approve such non-racemic drug for any condition of use in the therapeutic category in which the racemic drug has been approved.
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: If applicable, the labeling of a non-racemic drug described in paragraph (1) and with respect to which the applicant has made the election provided for by such paragraph shall include a statement that the non-racemic drug is not approved, and has not been shown to be safe and effective, for any condition of use of the racemic drug.
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this subsection, the term "therapeutic category" means a therapeutic category identified in the list developed by the United States Pharmacopeia pursuant to section 1395w–104(b)(3)(C)(ii) of title 42 and as in effect on September 27, 2007.

heading: New drugs
body_text: The Secretary shall publish the list described in subparagraph (A) and may amend such list by regulation.
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The election referred to in paragraph (1) may be made only in an application that is submitted to the Secretary after September 27, 2007, and before October 1, 2027.
label: FD&C Act § 505(bb)(4) [21 U.S.C. 355(bb)(4)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Notwithstanding any provision of the Food and Drug Administration Modernization Act of 1997 or any other provision of law, a sponsor of a drug that is the subject of an application described in subparagraph (B)(i) shall be eligible for, with respect to the drug, the 3-year exclusivity period referred to under clauses (iii) and (iv) of subsection (c)(3)(E) and under clauses (iii) and (iv) of subsection (j)(5)(F), subject to the requirements of such clauses, as applicable.
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(1)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(1)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) Application; antibiotic drug described

heading: New drugs
body_text: An application described in this clause is an application for marketing submitted under this section after October 8, 2008, in which the drug that is the subject of the application contains an antibiotic drug described in clause (ii).
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(1)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(1)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: An antibiotic drug described in this clause is an antibiotic drug that was the subject of an application approved by the Secretary under section 357 of this title (as in effect before November 21, 1997).

heading: New drugs
body_text: Notwithstanding any provision of the Food and Drug Administration Modernization Act of 1997 or any other provision of law, a sponsor of a drug that is the subject of an application described in subparagraph (B)(i) may elect to be eligible for, with respect to the drug—
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (i)(I) the 3-year exclusivity period referred to under clauses (iii) and (iv) of subsection (c)(3)(E) and under clauses (iii) and (iv) of subsection (j)(5)(F), subject to the requirements of such clauses, as applicable; and
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(2)(A)(i)(I) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(2)(A)(i)(I)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (II) the 5-year exclusivity period referred to under clause (ii) of subsection (c)(3)(E) and under clause (ii) of subsection (j)(5)(F), subject to the requirements of such clauses, as applicable; or
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(2)(A)(i)(II) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(2)(A)(i)(II)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (ii) a patent term extension under section 156 of title 35, subject to the requirements of such section.

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) Application; antibiotic drug described

heading: New drugs
body_text: An application described in this clause is an application for marketing submitted under this section after October 8, 2008, in which the drug that is the subject of the application contains an antibiotic drug described in clause (ii).
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(2)(B)(i) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(2)(B)(i)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: An antibiotic drug described in this clause is an antibiotic drug that was the subject of 1 or more applications received by the Secretary under section 357 of this title (as in effect before November 21, 1997), none of which was approved by the Secretary under such section.
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(2)(B)(ii) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(2)(B)(ii)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Paragraphs (1)(A) and (2)(A) shall not be construed to entitle a drug that is the subject of an approved application described in subparagraphs 5 (1)(B)(i) or (2)(B)(i), as applicable, to any market exclusivities or patent extensions other than those exclusivities or extensions described in paragraph (1)(A) or (2)(A).
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(3)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(3)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Paragraphs (1)(A) and (2)(A)(i) shall not apply to any condition of use for which the drug referred to in subparagraph (1)(B)(i) or (2)(B)(i), as applicable, was approved before October 8, 2008.
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: Notwithstanding section 125, or any other provision, of the Food and Drug Administration Modernization Act of 1997, or any other provision of law, and subject to the limitations in paragraphs (1), (2), and (3), the provisions of the Drug Price Competition and Patent Term Restoration Act of 1984 shall apply to any drug subject to paragraph (1) or any drug with respect to which an election is made under paragraph (2)(A).
label: FD&C Act § 505(v)(4) [21 U.S.C. 355(v)(4)]

heading: New drugs
paragraph_heading: Deadline for determination on certain petitions
body_text: The Secretary shall issue a final, substantive determination on a petition submitted pursuant to subsection (b) of section 314.161 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or any successor regulations), no later than 270 days after the date the petition is submitted.
top_caption: Deadline for determination on certain petitions
label: FD&C Act § 505(w) [21 U.S.C. 355(w)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: In the case of an application under subsection (b) with respect to a drug for which the Secretary provides notice to the sponsor that the Secretary intends to issue a scientific and medical evaluation and recommend controls under the Controlled Substances Act [21 U.S.C. 801 et seq.], approval of such application shall not take effect until the interim final rule controlling the drug is issued in accordance with section 201(j) of the Controlled Substances Act [21 U.S.C. 811(j)].
top_caption: Date of approval in the case of recommended controls under the CSA
label: FD&C Act § 505(x)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(x)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this section, with respect to an application described in paragraph (1), the term "date of approval" shall mean the later of—
top_caption: Date of approval in the case of recommended controls under the CSA
label: FD&C Act § 505(x)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(x)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) the date an application under subsection (b) is approved under subsection (c); or
top_caption: Date of approval in the case of recommended controls under the CSA
label: FD&C Act § 505(x)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(x)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) the date of issuance of the interim final rule controlling the drug.
top_caption: Date of approval in the case of recommended controls under the CSA
label: FD&C Act § 505(x)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(x)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: The sponsor of a contrast agent for which an application has been approved under this section may submit a supplement to the application seeking approval for a new use following the authorization of a premarket submission for an applicable medical imaging device for that use with the contrast agent pursuant to section 360j(p)(1) of this title.
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: In reviewing a supplement submitted under this subsection, the agency center charged with the premarket review of drugs may—
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) consult with the center charged with the premarket review of devices; and
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) review information and data submitted to the Secretary by the sponsor of an applicable medical imaging device pursuant to section 360e, 360(k), or 360c(f)(2) of this title so long as the sponsor of such applicable medical imaging device has provided to the sponsor of the contrast agent a right of reference.
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this subsection—
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) the term "new use" means a use of a contrast agent that is described in the approved labeling of an applicable medical imaging device described in section 360j(p) of this title, but that is not described in the approved labeling of the contrast agent; and
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(3)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(3)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) the terms "applicable medical imaging device" and "contrast agent" have the meanings given such terms in section 360j(p) of this title.
top_caption: Contrast agents intended for use with applicable medical imaging devices
label: FD&C Act § 505(y)(3)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(y)(3)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: For purposes of this section, the term "nonclinical test" means a test conducted in vitro, in silico, or in chemico, or a nonhuman in vivo test, that occurs before or during the clinical trial phase of the investigation of the safety and effectiveness of a drug. Such test may include the following:
label: FD&C Act § 505(z) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (1) Cell-based assays.
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (2) Organ chips and microphysiological systems.
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (3) Computer modeling.
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (4) Other nonhuman or human biology-based test methods, such as bioprinting.
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(4) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(4)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (5) Animal tests.
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(5) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(5)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (1) With respect to a clinical investigation of a new drug that is a phase 3 study, as defined in section 312.21(c) of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations (or successor regulations), or, as appropriate, another pivotal study of a new drug (other than bioavailability or bioequivalence studies), the sponsor of such drug shall submit to the Secretary a diversity action plan.
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(1) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(1)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (2) Such diversity action plan shall include—
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(2) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(2)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (A) the sponsor's goals for enrollment in such clinical study;
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(2)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(2)(A)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (B) the sponsor's rationale for such goals; and
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(2)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(2)(B)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (C) an explanation of how the sponsor intends to meet such goals.
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(2)(C) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(2)(C)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (3) The sponsor shall submit to the Secretary such diversity action plan, in the form and manner specified by the Secretary in guidance, as soon as practicable but not later than the date on which the sponsor submits the protocol to the Secretary for such a phase 3 study or other pivotal study of the drug. The sponsor may submit modifications to the diversity action plan. Any such modifications shall be in the form and manner specified by the Secretary in guidance.
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(3) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(3)]

heading: New drugs
body_text: (4)(A) On the initiative of the Secretary or at the request of a sponsor, the Secretary may waive any requirement in paragraph (1), (2), or (3) if the Secretary determines that a waiver is necessary based on what is known or what can be determined about the prevalence or incidence of the disease or condition for which the new drug is under investigation (including in terms of the patient population that may use the drug), if conducting a clinical investigation in accordance with a diversity action plan would otherwise be impracticable, or if such waiver is necessary to protect public health during a public health emergency.
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(4)(A) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(4)(A)]

body_text: (B) The Secretary shall issue a written response granting or denying a request from a sponsor for a waiver within 60 days of receiving such request.
top_caption: 6 Diversity action plan for clinical studies 7
label: FD&C Act § 505(z)(4)(B) [21 U.S.C. 355(z)(4)(B)]
